name: Human-readable domain name
summary: One sentence: what kind of product this pack is for.
optimisesFor: The single reader or moment this domain optimises for. Be specific enough that it excludes something.

skill.name: REPLACE-ME-ui-design
skill.description: What to build, plus WHEN to use this pack. An assistant selects a skill from this string alone, so name the artefacts (screens, components) and the trigger phrases a user would actually type.

when: the kind of screen this pack covers
a phrasing a user would type that should select it
a domain signal - the product type, the audience, the constraint

platform.note: What the user is pointing with. One or more of fine-pointer, touch, glance, remote, gaze - the first is what the domain is designed around. Anything other than fine-pointer requires minTarget, and it may not go below 24px.
